scenarios.name: Nagħrfu lil xulxin
scenarios.goal_en: Greet, exchange names, say where you're from and where you live.
scenarios.tutor_role: A friendly Maltese neighbour meeting you for the first time outside your building.
scenarios.opener_en: Good morning! I'm Marija. What's your name?

scenarios.name: Fil-kafetterija
scenarios.goal_en: Order a drink and something to eat, ask the price, pay.
scenarios.tutor_role: A barista in a small café in Tas-Sliema.
scenarios.opener_en: Good morning! What would you like?

scenarios.name: Insaqsi t-triq
scenarios.goal_en: Stop someone politely, ask where a place is, understand left/right/straight.
scenarios.opener_en: Yes, tell me. How can I help you?

scenarios.name: Fis-suq
scenarios.goal_en: Buy fruit and vegetables, handle quantities and prices, haggle a little.
scenarios.tutor_role: A stallholder at the Marsaxlokk Sunday market.
scenarios.opener_en: Come, come! Fresh fruit! What will you take?

scenarios.name: Il-familja
scenarios.goal_en: Describe your family, ages, who lives where.
scenarios.tutor_role: A curious Maltese friend over coffee.
scenarios.opener_mt: Mela, għidli ftit fuq il-familja tiegħek.
scenarios.opener_en: So, tell me a bit about your family.

scenarios.name: It-temp
scenarios.goal_en: Small talk about the weather and plans for the day.
scenarios.tutor_role: A neighbour on the balcony making small talk.
scenarios.opener_mt: Kemm hu sabiħ it-temp illum, hux?
scenarios.opener_en: The weather is lovely today, isn't it?

scenarios.name: Fir-ristorant
scenarios.goal_en: Book a table, order a full meal, ask about dishes, pay.
scenarios.tutor_role: A waiter at a fish restaurant in Marsaxlokk.
scenarios.opener_en: Good evening! Do you have a reservation?

scenarios.name: Ix-xogħol
scenarios.goal_en: Describe your job and daily routine with times.
scenarios.tutor_role: A colleague chatting during a coffee break.
scenarios.opener_en: So, what do you do for work?

scenarios.name: Nivvjaġġaw
scenarios.goal_en: Buy a ticket, ask about bus and ferry times, get to Gozo.
scenarios.tutor_role: A ticket clerk at the Ċirkewwa ferry terminal.
scenarios.opener_en: Good morning, where are you heading?

scenarios.name: Għand it-tabib
scenarios.goal_en: Describe symptoms and understand simple advice.
scenarios.tutor_role: A GP at a health centre.
scenarios.opener_en: Good morning. Tell me, what's wrong?

scenarios.name: X'taħseb?
scenarios.goal_en: Give opinions, agree and disagree, tell a short story about your week.
scenarios.tutor_role: A close Maltese friend who wants the gossip.
scenarios.opener_mt: Mela, x'għamilt dan l-aħħar? Għidli kollox.
scenarios.opener_en: So, what have you been up to lately? Tell me everything.

scenarios.name: Il-festa tar-raħal
scenarios.goal_en: Talk about Maltese traditions, food and celebrations.
scenarios.tutor_role: An enthusiastic villager during the feast of the local patron saint.
scenarios.opener_mt: Ġejt għall-festa? Ara kemm hemm nies!
scenarios.opener_en: Did you come for the festa? Look how many people there are!

scenarios.name: Taħdita ħielsa
scenarios.goal_en: Talk about whatever you like; the tutor adapts to your level.
scenarios.tutor_role: A patient Maltese conversation partner who follows your lead.
scenarios.opener_mt: Bonġu! Fuq xiex tixtieq titkellem illum?
scenarios.opener_en: Good morning! What would you like to talk about today?
